data.name: Solward
data.detailed_description:
After a long voyage in space, the mercenaries Kali, Jenna, and Heather (and their trusty android Paul) have returned home only to find that their planet has been invaded by an alien threat.

Fight your way through an infested starbase, rescue the remaining trapped Humans, build a resistance to battle the invasion, and defeat the alien queen. You'll need to do everything you possibly can to sabotage, impede, and ultimately defeat the invaders. Gather equipment and skills to improve your chances of saving your planet and finally getting back to a normal life.

Solward is a sci-fi tactical RPG where you control a group of four characters in turn-based tactical combat.
